head: Data work, and a game jam award
bio: Started the degree in September 2023. Built and maintained a relational product database of 1,000+ SKUs at Knownautoparts, and took Best Sound Design at Global Game Jam 2024.

head: Catalogue search, traffic up 35%
bio: Restructured product categories at Knownautoparts for search, which lifted organic traffic 35%. Invigilated exams for the Student Accessibility Centre and held Sexton Scholar standing.

head: Research, and the first grants
bio: Worked as an undergraduate research assistant on Greenland ice segmentation, became Treasurer of the Dalhousie Machine Learning Society, and earned AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner.

head: First co-op, and a hackathon award
bio: Joined SpryPoint as a software developer, working on a municipal utility billing platform. Took 1st place in the Machine Learning category at SURGE NeuroHack 2026 with SPECTRA-ICA, which I built with Team DMLS.

head: Graduation
bio: Graduating May 2027 with a Bachelor of Computer Science (Honours). Open to new grad roles.
